class_interactions.description: NSAIDs increase bleeding risk when combined with anticoagulants through additive effects on hemostasis.
class_interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination if possible. Use acetaminophen for pain. If unavoidable, use lowest NSAID dose for shortest duration.

class_interactions.description: SSRIs and MAOIs together can cause fatal serotonin syndrome via synergistic serotonergic overactivity.
class_interactions.recommendation: Absolutely contraindicated. Adequate washout period required between discontinuation and initiation.

class_interactions.description: CYP3A4 inhibitors can significantly increase plasma levels of CYP3A4 substrates, potentiating both therapeutic and toxic effects.
class_interactions.recommendation: Consider dose reduction of the substrate drug or use of an alternative agent not metabolized by CYP3A4.

class_interactions.description: CYP1A2 inhibitors can increase levels of CYP1A2 substrates by reducing their hepatic clearance.
class_interactions.recommendation: Monitor substrate drug levels and adjust dose accordingly. Consider alternative agents.

class_interactions.description: Both drug classes independently raise serum potassium, creating additive hyperkalemia risk.
class_interactions.recommendation: Monitor serum potassium closely if combination is necessary. Consider alternative diuretic class.
